note: regenerated by m08_compromise.py; access dates and the raw-XML hash are kept from the run that downloaded the data

cars.dataset: Fuel consumption ratings, Natural Resources Canada
cars.resource: 2026 Fuel Consumption Ratings (2026-10-06): newest model year in the dataset
cars.encoding: UTF-8 (plain ASCII); the MY2024 file in the same dataset needed a Latin-1 or cp1252 decoder
cars.scope_note: internal-combustion ratings only (fuel types Z, X, D, E); battery-electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles are separate files in the dataset and are left out
cars.no_price_no_mileage: This data has no price and no mileage, so the class criteria Price and Milage cannot be used.

houses.dataset: Rôle d'évaluation foncière du Québec, municipality 23027 (Ville de Québec), 2026 roll
houses.filter: RL0105A = 1000 (predominant use: dwelling), RL0311A = 1 (one dwelling), RL0309A = 1 (detached), RL0201U = 1 (land owner, so no condominium units), no rooms for rent (RL0312A) and no commercial premises (RL0313A); then complete fields and plausible ranges
houses.not_an_asking_price: value is RL0404A, the assessed value of land plus building at the roll's reference date, not an asking or sale price
houses.label_note: address = civic number + generic + street name from RL0101; the link particle (de, du, des) is omitted and generic codes are expanded by inference (RU rue, AV avenue, BO boulevard, ...); unknown codes stay raw
